program.blurb: A week from every shelf with one kettlebell: bell strength, boxing, bell cardio, yoga and mobility.
program.about: A full week from every part of the library, with one kettlebell. Bell legs and hips, boxing bouts, bell presses and rows, a mobility and balance day, a mixed day of bell lifts and bouts, bell conditioning and a power yoga flow take turns. No two neighbouring days load the same muscles. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
